svg.title: Division / analysis / חלוק
svg.desc: Chapter 11, Hebrew pp241–245, English pp242–246. One bounded whole is partitioned into two regions, then smaller subregions. The regions together cover the whole without gaps or overlaps. Deeper subdivisions remain inside their parent regions. Counts and areas are illustrative, not numerical claims. This is recursive analysis of a topic, distinct from the existing Parts badge and from a syllogistic inference tree.
